title: analise-cerrado-ma: Expansion of deforestation in the Cerrado of Maranhão State, Brazil (2001-2023)
description: Code and data used in the article "Expansão do desmatamento no cerrado maranhense entre os anos de 2001 – 2023" (Revista Tocantinense de Geografia, v. 15, n. 35, 2026). Jupyter notebooks analyse PRODES Cerrado deforestation data (INPE, TerraBrasilis) for the Cerrado of Maranhão, Brazil, by biome, microregion and municipality. Includes an English companion report (report_en.pdf) generated from the notebooks.
